registry_correction: SN: unit is the individual with a family reduction by parts (not a family quotient); main statute confirmed (Loi 2012-31, DGID edition Jan. 2025 incl. LF 2025).
headline: Senegal 2025 built from the DGID's January 2025 CGI: barème 0-43 % on wages less 30 % (cap 900 000 F), a family reduction by parts that is a bounded share of the tax (not a quotient), final 10 %/8 % on dividends/bank interest, and a TRIMF step levy whose 12 M F step makes net pay fall by 18 000 F.
